Privacy

How information is handled when you visit this static website or choose to contact the firm.

Discuss your matter
Privacy noticeWebsiteEmail enquiriesYour choices

A minimal, static website.

This website does not use an enquiry form, advertising cookies or on-site analytics. It is hosted by Vercel, whose infrastructure may process standard technical request information such as an IP address, browser details, requested page and timestamp for delivery, reliability and security.

Information you send by email.

If you choose to email the firm, the information you provide is used to review and respond to the enquiry, carry out conflict checks where appropriate and manage any professional relationship that is subsequently agreed. Please do not send confidential documents before the firm confirms it can act.

Email is handled through the service associated with the published Gmail address. Its processing is also governed by the relevant provider terms and privacy practices.

Your choices and questions.

You decide what to include in an initial enquiry. Keep it concise and avoid unnecessary personal or sensitive information. For a privacy question concerning an email you sent to the firm, contact susanmutelaw@gmail.com.
